title: Property certificate of registration
summary: This page provides information on applying for and managing a property certificate of registration.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a property certificate of registration?
faqs.a: You can apply for a property certificate of registration using the dedicated transaction page.

faqs.q: Can I apply for a property certificate under mutual recognition?
faqs.a: Yes, you can apply for a property certificate under mutual recognition.

faqs.q: What if I need to change details on my property certificate or licence?
faqs.a: You can change the details on your property certificate or licence through the relevant transaction page.
